implementation_notes: TypeScript compiles away, so measure the emitted JavaScript, not the source. Most real web performance cost is network, layout and main-thread work — measure those with the Performance panel and RUM rather than micro-optimising TypeScript-level code.
idiom_name: measure emitted JS + RUM/long-task measurement in the browser
pitfalls: Debating generic vs monomorphised TypeScript when both erase to the same JS
Optimising code the browser never runs on the slow path
